outcome: death during antibiotic treatment for late onset sepsis
cohort: The study included 112 preterm newborns (<= 32 weeks gestational age, mean 26.9 +/- 2.3 weeks) diagnosed with late onset sepsis.
finding: Neonatal SOFA score demonstrated greater discriminatory capacity for predicting late onset sepsis-related mortality compared to SIRS criteria, with scores at onset of sepsis and 6 hours later being significant predictors.
gest_age: Preterm newborns <= 32 weeks, with a mean gestational age of 26.9 ± 2.3 weeks.
